virtueforge.title: VirtueForge
virtueforge.fullDescription: A local-first Stoicism practice app: daily focus, journal, and Franklin-style virtue tracking.
virtueforge.detailedDescription: VirtueForge helps build character habits with Stoic pillars and Benjamin Franklin’s 13 virtues. The Flutter client keeps the journal on-device; a NestJS content API serves quotes and essays (Portico / Temple). I own the mobile product, Content Studio admin, and production API.
features: Privacy-first: no analytics SDK in the core loop

vpn.title: GoodWin VPN
vpn.fullDescription: Open-source local VPN client: import your own server config, system VPN on Android and iOS.
vpn.detailedDescription: GoodWin VPN is a Flutter client for configurations you already have (share link, QR, HTTPS subscription). Connect starts a system VPN tunnel. Supports Xray, Hysteria 2, and TrustTunnel. No Goodwin-operated proxy in the store listing — the app is a client, not a VPN service marketplace.
features: Import via link, QR, or subscription URL
System VPN on Android and iOS
EN/RU UI and public privacy policy
